in_sanskrit.name: Hiransh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Golden Ray
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hiransh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hiransh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hiranyas', meaning 'golden'. The name is associated with the god Hiranyakashipu, who was covered in gold. Hiransh is believed to represent power, wealth, and good fortune.

in_hindi.name: हिरंश
in_hindi.meaning: शिरों का अनुभव (experience of the head)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who experiences the bliss of the head, possibly referring to a deep thinker or someone who is wise and insightful.

in_tamil.name: ஹிரந்ச்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Combination of the names Hiram and Ansh. Hiram is a name of biblical origin, meaning 'mountain of God'. Ansh means 'essence' or 'soul'. So Hiransh could mean 'Essence of God' or 'Soul of God'.

in_telugu.name: హిరంశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Combination of the names Hiram and Sh. Hiram is a name of biblical origin, meaning 'mountain of God'. Sh is a letter in the Telugu alphabet and can also mean 'god' or 'Lord'. So Hiransh could mean 'God of Gods' or 'Lord of Lords'.

in_marathi.name: Hiransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiransh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hiranyas', meaning 'golden'. The name is associated with the god Hiranyakashipu, who was covered in gold. Hiransh is believed to represent power, wealth, and good fortune.
